description: Executable acceptance, falsification, scope, and rejection gates for all 23 canonical framework claims.

acceptance_criteria: Dimensions 1, 2, 4, and 8 pass declared identities and a nonzero sedenion zero divisor is reproduced.
rejection_criteria: Reject division or composition above dimension 8 when a nonzero zero divisor is constructed.

acceptance_criteria: Define a dimensional state map, measured observable, retained raw data, and matched algebra-free control.
rejection_criteria: Reject physical interpretation when algebraic labels have no observable map or matched control.

acceptance_criteria: Identify F4 as the Albert automorphism group and E6 and E7 only through appropriate structure and conformal functors.
rejection_criteria: Reject J3(S) as an Albert algebra and reject E7 as its automorphism group.

acceptance_criteria: Enumerate the six D4 diagram automorphisms that permute the three outer nodes.
rejection_criteria: Reject extensions of triality when no representation and induced action are defined.

acceptance_criteria: E9 has determinant 0 and one null direction; E10 and E11 have determinants -1 and -2 and one negative direction each.
rejection_criteria: Reject classification as finite-dimensional exceptional simple Lie algebras.

acceptance_criteria: State the truncation, field dictionary, equations matched, and first unmatched term.
rejection_criteria: Reject complete-unification scope broader than the demonstrated truncated correspondence.

acceptance_criteria: Define the Monster representation, modular object, state space, evolution operator, and stability inequality.
rejection_criteria: Reject physical stability language without an operator bridge and matched control.

acceptance_criteria: Name the measure, metric, limiting procedure, estimator, and admissible domain.
rejection_criteria: Reject literal negative spatial axes derived from formal or multifractal dimensions.

acceptance_criteria: Recover exact controls across three resolutions with stable scale windows and estimator agreement.
rejection_criteria: Classify values as finite-resolution diagnostics when refinement and window stability are absent.

acceptance_criteria: Supply a covariant action, stress tensor, background, perturbation equations, stability analysis, and distinguishing observable.
rejection_criteria: Reject generic sourced scalar equations that do not close the field equations or distinguish an existing model.

acceptance_criteria: Close calibrated input, output, storage, thermal, electromagnetic, mechanical, and uncertainty channels over a complete cycle.
rejection_criteria: Reject extraction when the complete balance does not close or any input channel is unmeasured.

acceptance_criteria: Measure drive work, dissipation, stored energy, output work, and uncertainty over integer drive periods.
rejection_criteria: Reject amplification when subharmonic response is called production or drive work is omitted.

acceptance_criteria: Derive common field content, action, couplings, low-energy limits, and a distinguishing prediction.
rejection_criteria: Reject unification when only E_P/l_P=c^4/G and algebraic hbar cancellation are shown.

acceptance_criteria: Define domain, codomain, operator law, closure, continuity, and a discriminating observable.
rejection_criteria: Exclude metaphor-only operators with no mathematical law or measurable consequence.

acceptance_criteria: Express every generated root as an integral combination of the simple roots and therefore in Q.
rejection_criteria: Reject nonzero P/Q charges assigned to roots because roots represent the zero coset.

acceptance_criteria: Enumerate every Z^2 to Z/2 homomorphism and identify the nontrivial D4-invariant map.
rejection_criteria: Reject homomorphic filtering when no exact triad is rejected.

acceptance_criteria: Define currents, level, stress tensor, Ward identities, fluid variables, dimensional map, and dispersion relation.
rejection_criteria: Reject transfer by label when no operator or dimensional dictionary exists.

acceptance_criteria: Trace beta into evolution and demonstrate converged zonal energy, jet count, anisotropy, and uncertainty.
rejection_criteria: Reject the historical claim when beta is absent and zonal energy is negligible.

acceptance_criteria: Implement beta dynamics, preregister refinements and seeds, and require quotient-filter and identity trajectories to match.
rejection_criteria: Reject an algebraic effect if a filter that removes no triads changes the trajectory or controls are unmatched.

acceptance_criteria: Equilibrium sums to density at nonzero velocity and periodic evolution conserves mass within 1e-10.
rejection_criteria: Fail repaired status on any equilibrium or periodic mass-conservation regression.

acceptance_criteria: Separate conventional responses from novelty and require raw data, full energy balance, blinded controls, and replication.
rejection_criteria: Reject a novel energy effect when only conventional material responses are measured.

acceptance_criteria: State weak-field, slow-motion, gauge, source, and normalization assumptions.
rejection_criteria: Reject claims that the analogy creates an independent force or replaces nonlinear Einstein equations.

acceptance_criteria: Define intervention, observable, comparator, blinding, threshold, and replication protocol.
rejection_criteria: Exclude resonance language with no operational observable or discriminating experiment.
